item.title: RodeoHouston names 2026 World's Championship Bar-B-Que Contest winners
item.description: RodeoHouston has named the winners of the 2026 World's Championship Bar-B-Que Contest.

item.title: Off-duty Pct. 3 deputy shoots at suspects outside Atascocita-area business, Houston police say
item.description: Officials said the off-duty Precinct 3 deputy identified themself as an officer to the suspects allegedly assaulting someone in a northeast Houston parking lot, before firing shots at them.

item.title: Iran vows revenge after the killing of its top leader and trades strikes with Israel in widening war
item.description: Iran has vowed revenge after the killing of its supreme leader.

item.title: Man hospitalized after Texas City shooting near SH 146, suspect in custody, according to police
item.description: Police said they arrested the 22-year-old suspect after he allegedly shot at a man, sending the victim to the hospital.

item.title: 4 people charged in connection to 12 car burglaries at RodeoHouston event, court documents say
item.description: Four people broke into 12 cars at a Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo event over the weekend, court documents allege.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara wins posthumous Actor Award for 'The Studio'; Seth Rogan accepts on her behalf
item.description: A month after her unexpected death, Catherine O'Hara won a posthumous award at the 32nd Actor Awards for her performance on "The Studio." Seth Rogan accepted on her behalf, saying O'Hara "showed that you could be a genius and you could be kind."

item.title: It's a quiet start to the work week before rain and storm chances climb
item.description: Monday will be another sunny and warm day before rain and storm chances return this week.

item.title: Oil prices rise sharply in market trading after attacks in Middle East disrupt global energy supply
item.description: Oil prices rose sharply when market trading began Sunday, as U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran and retaliatory strikes against Israel and U.S. military installations around the Gulf sent disruptions through the global energy supply chain.

item.title: Austin shooting suspect who killed 2, injured 14 had indicators of potential ties to terrorism: FBI
item.description: The FBI said it is investigating "indicators on the suspect and in his vehicle" that show potential ties to terrorism.

item.title: Houston area voters tell ABC13 what's important to them ahead of Primary Day
item.description: As Primary Day in Texas inches closer, Houston area voters tell ABC13 what issues are driving them to the polls.
